newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX Dec natgas hits new all-time high at expiry.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX Dec natgas hits new all-time high at expiry.

text.p: The New York Mercantile Exchange December spot month natural gas contract, for delivery at Henry Hub, La., hit an all-time high of $4.00 per million British thermal units (mmBtu) shortly before its expiration at the end of Thursday's session.
The rise capped a 53 percent run higher for the spot month in the past six sessions.
Traders' explanatory refrain throughout the rally cited useasonally early cold in much of the nation and concerns over supply shortages, which lag year-ago levels by about six percent.
The January contract, which moves into the spot month position at Thursday's close, was also up sharply, trading at $3.32 ahead of the close, a 5.6-cent rise from Wednesday.
